description: Live safety check of an XRP Ledger token (issued currency). Detects fake look-alikes of famous tokens (e.g. a fake RLUSD), issuers that can still mint, freeze or claw back, global freezes, transfer fees, unverified domains, whale concentration, thin AMM liquidity and brand-new issuers. Returns a verdict (High risk / Caution / No red flags found / Not enough data), the reasons behind it with the exact ledger facts, and a one-sentence spoken summary.

currency.description: Token ticker as shown in wallets (e.g. RLUSD, SOLO) or its 40-character hex currency code.

issuer.description: The token issuer's XRPL address (starts with r).

name: check_token_safety

reasons.description: The top reasons behind the verdict, most important first.

score.description: 0-100 mechanical score; not a safety probability. Clawback is a high-risk control-policy failure.

spoken_summary.description: One or two sentences ready for text-to-speech.

title: Check an XRPL token's safety
